subject: general
question: Jabalpur is located on the banks of which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jabalpur** is a city in the central Indian state of **Madhya Pradesh. **
 
• It is situated on the **northern bank of the Narmada River **and is **surrounded by the Satpura Range** of mountains.
 
• It has witnessed the rule of **various dynasties, including the Gond, Maratha, and British empires.**
 
• Jabalpur is famous for the **Marble Rocks**, a stunning gorge on the Narmada River that features** tall marble cliffs.**
